Switching -Backup and restore device configuration. -Cisco IOS upgrades and recovery (FTP, TFTP) -Troubleshoot connectivity issue, verify and validate Link errors, CRC Errors. -Monitor Switch availability or any other error and perform Triage with the respective team to resolve the issue. -Carry out standard changes related to desktop ports. -Carry out standard configuration on switch according to the template. -Carry out VLAN mapping to the interface, port mapping. -VLAN configuration over switches and make machines communicate in LAN & WAN connectivity. -LAN technologies - Ethernet, Fast Ethernet, Gigabit Ethernet. -perform port aggregation & Link configuration: Access/Trunk. -Configuration and troubleshooting of VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, Interswitch connectivity. -Configuration and troubleshooting of Trunk ports, VTP (v1&v2). -Configuration and troubleshooting of STP protocols and STP protection. -Implemented CDP, LLDP, EtherChannel.
-Configuration HSRP, VRRP.
Routing -Backup and restore device configuration -Troubleshoot network connectivity issues using ICMP, ping, and traceroute -Monitor routers and links for hardware and performance issues. -Triage for Link issues with appropriate vendors. -Troubleshooting, overutilization, Reachability, VPN connectivity. -Apply standard SOP based configuration on the router.(AAA,TACACS,Radius,Banner,VPN Configurations) -Configuration of NAT/PAT,ACL -Configuration/Troubleshoot of Static, Dynamic (OSPF & EIGRP), and Default Routing protocols. -Configure, verify, and troubleshoot IPv4 addressing, Subnetting,Supernetting, ARP, and Route Summarization -Basics of BGP
Firewall: - -Restore and backup device settings -Used Fortinet Manager to Upgrades/installs OS to Fortigate Firewalls in accordance with recommendations to maintain them up to date. -Using FortiManager, provision firewall policies on Fortinet FortiGate appliances. -Implementing rules to allow or restrict IPs, and creating policies in response to requests from business users. -FortiGate CPE 40/60/80/100 series Firewall configuration, management, and FortiAnalyzer series 4000 (logging and reporting server), FortiManager series 3000/4000 (centralized control) firewalls -Analyze the logs and troubleshoot any connectivity problems.
WLAN -Monitor WAP, and Triage issue with respective teams. -Troubleshooting Connectivity issue from an end-user perspective. -Troubleshooting the WAP isolation issue, Cannot Connect to SSID,Slow Performance, Intermittent Disconnections

Designation: Network Engineers
Client:Société Generale Global Solution|| 3M India
28th Apr’21 to 16th July 26
Roles and Responsibilities
1)Join calls with customer to understand their requirement.
2)Replacement and refreshment & upgrade of existing network device such as FortiGate
firewall,router,switches,ethernet (copper,fiber optics 10/40/100G).
3)prepare all pre-deployment documentation for replacement, refreshment, upgrades, and
implementation.
4)Troubleshoot and resolve issues as they arise after migration.
5)Adding rule in FortiGate firewall
6)Designing rule & creating Incident Record arises after migration.
7)Do changes in network (which includes IOS upgradation, Route the traffic from Primary to
secondary if Primary link is flapping, adding vlan, adding a routes)
8)Investigate health issues of ports and interfaces for routers and switches, ensuring
connectivity with agreed speed, duplex, and bandwidth.
9)Attending weekly change approval board meeting for getting approval from change board.
10)Manage the delivery include validation, approval, feasibility, target delivery timeliness and
implementation of order as per customer requirement.
and ensure new equipment is registered and added to the inventory management system
11) Planning and implementing of customer changes, based around an ITIL framework.
12)coordinating with remote hand support engineer for the O&M activities.
13)Handle day to day security P3 and P4 incidents.
14)Working closely with partner management teams to such as Verizon, AT&T,
SingTel,Telstra,OBS,COLT for provisioning new circuits activation and deactivation within
SLA.
and proper destruction and decommission of existing network device such as FortiGate
firewall,router,switches
15)Timely completion of given activity and to generate daily link utilization report with SLA
achievement more than 95%

07th Oct-16 TO 09th Apr-21
Prolink Computers Pvt Ltd 14th Dec-15 TO 31st Aug-16
Designation: Network Engineers
Client: Vijaya Bank HQ Datacenter
Roles and Responsibilities
-Providing 24 x 7 Technical Support.
-L1 and L2 Support Vijaya Bank Data Center (DC) As well as Data Recovery ( DR)
-Managing and Configuring Routers and Switches.(HP and Cisco )
-Identify and Resolving network-related problems
-Provided accurate documentation for network topology, policies, procedures, and change
protocol
-Support and Resolving Core level Switches and Router as well as LAN Network Related
Problem
-Monthly / Weekly Backup of all Networking Devices
-Documentation of the Bandwidth, uptime/ Downtime, and configuration details
-Troubleshooting LAN and WAN network problems and related issues
-Implemented and Migrated Networking Components of HP 59XX, HP 55XX, Cisco 2960
Switch, Cisco2900.
-Monitoring Multiple Vendor MPLS Links and resolving the related problem
-Configuring and troubleshooting standard and Extended ACL, L2, and L3 Vlan, Routing,
uplinks, and Static routing.
D.S Infotech Pvt. Ltd. 17th Feb-14 TO 06th Jul-14
Designation: I.T Engineer
Client: Air India limited
Roles and Responsibilities
-Monitoring, managing, and troubleshooting of complete Air India Network.
-Monitor and Maintain Cisco Router (1900), Switches (2960, 3750), and Firewalls (5510).
-To check the performance-related faults like (packet loss, latency, slow speed, utilization
report)
-To check the connectivity status of ADSL, Lease Line, and MPLS connection.
-Coordinating with Telco to report and isolate the issue (Circuit down, intermittent, packet
loss, Chronic issues, etc.)
-Configuring & managing the various type of printers like Intermac, Fujitsu, and HP LaserJet
Printers.
-Coordinate with the various Vendors for Hardware related issues.
-Update the Servers and all client systems from time to time by update packages and Anti-
virus.
-Complete given work Orders on time-related to Airlines Software updates.
-Responsible for configuring and test any new hardware and software.
-Installing the software, operating systems, and server operating systems such as Liaison,
SITA Cute System.
-Managed and Administered Windows XP and Windows 7 workstations and laptops.
-Working in 24*7 Shifts according to the Roaster made by line manager.
Academic Profile
-Completed M.Tech (Wireless and Network Security)in May 2013 from Vel-tech Chennai in
association with CDAC Pune
-Completed B.Tech (Electronics and Communication) in May 2011 from INSTITUTION OF
ENGINEERS (INDIA)GIET, CHENNAI.
-Completed HSC in 2002 From Millar High School, Patna (B.I.E.C).
-Completed SSC in 2000 From St Paul’s Academy, Patna (I.C.S.C.E)
Personality
I am calm. I communicate easily same in an environment under pressure. Throughout my
professional life, the information exchange, the analysis of needs makes part of my criteria. I
take time to reflect before acting.
